svg.title: Friend on Campus AWS architecture
svg.desc: Browsers reach CloudFront, a public ALB and the NGINX gateway. ECS on three EC2 hosts runs two frontends, six backends, RabbitMQ and Debezium. RDS stores six service databases. Debezium publishes outbox changes to RabbitMQ through a private NLB; backends publish and consume messages. EBS retains broker data and EFS retains connector checkpoints. Supporting services provide images, secrets, logs and private DNS; Order and Chat call external NUS SoCLaaS. This is a simplified configuration view, not a live AWS inventory.
svg.text: ECS ON EC2 · 3 HOSTS · ONE PUBLIC SUBNET / AZ
